senses.label: 注ぎ出す・こぼれる
senses.def: 液体・物を注ぎ出す、こぼす、こぼれる、散らす。
senses.def_en: To pour out, spill, or scatter liquid or objects; to be spilled.

senses.label: 血を流す
senses.def_en: To shed blood; for blood to be shed.

senses.label: 注ぐ（霊・愛・怒り）
senses.def: 御霊・愛・怒りなどを人に注ぎ与える。黙示録の鉢の注ぎを含む。
senses.def_en: To pour out the Spirit, love, wrath, and the like upon people. Includes the pouring out of the bowls in Revelation.

senses.label: 身をすっかり委ねる・身を投げ込む
senses.label_en: to give oneself wholly over / throw oneself into
senses.def: （比喩）誤りや欲望などに、身をすっかり委ねる、身を投げ込む。
senses.def_en: (Figurative) To give oneself wholly over to error, desire, and the like; to throw oneself into it.
